data.name: Asma
data.gender_notes: Asma is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root س-م-و (s-m-w); Asmāʾ is the plural of ism, 'name', and also carries the sense 'elevated'. Its root is س-م-و (s-m-w). Borne by Asmāʾ bint Abī Bakr, a companion of the Prophet ﷺ. Asma is a Arabic name meaning “Names; (also) high, elevated”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Asma expresses “Names; (also) high, elevated”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root س-م-و (s-m-w); Asmāʾ is the plural of ism, 'name', and also carries the sense 'elevated'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asma total 7, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
